description: devmode base-repository phase gate for Codex. The three events wired here reconstruct the SAME single phase-gate behavior that Claude's Stop hook (.claude/settings.json) gets for free by reading the session transcript: Codex hooks see one event at a time and carry state across them, so UserPromptSubmit records that the turn is a /devmode turn, PostToolUse records the delegation to devmode-orchestrator, and Stop decides. They are plumbing, not extra enforcement. The PostToolUse matcher is deliberately Agent|spawn_agent only, so tool calls such as Bash never reach it and the verification gate cannot fire in this repo. Safety guardrails and the verification gate are project-level opt-ins installed by install.sh --with-guardrails.
